connection.description:
Connection to the Mission Control database. Cost data is read with SQL because
the `configs` resource selector does not expose cost columns.

Names the connection the mission-control chart creates (its `connectionName`,
default `mission-control-db`). The namespace is left off so it resolves in the
namespace this chart is installed into.
connection.title: connection

currencies.description:
Currencies offered in the currency selector. Costs are never summed across
currencies, so every view filters to exactly one.
currencies.title: currencies

deduplicate.description:
Compensates for duplicate cost bookings left behind when a charge's
resolution target changes (see the chart README). Disable once the ingest
pipeline retires superseded bookings.
deduplicate.title: deduplicate

enabled.description:
Field that can be used as a condition when cost-view is a dependency.
This definition is only here as a placeholder such that it is included in
the json schema.
See https://helm.sh/docs/chart_best_practices/dependencies/#conditions-and-tags
for more info.
+docs:hidden
enabled.title: enabled

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

ownershipKeys.description:
Tag/label keys offered in the "group by" selector for ownership attribution.
Each is looked up on the config item's labels first, then its tags.
ownershipKeys.title: ownershipKeys

rootConfigTypes.description:
Config types that spend is booked against when it cannot be resolved to a
resource of its own — tax, support, credits, and resources the scraper has
not discovered yet. Used to separate attributable from account-level spend.
rootConfigTypes.title: rootConfigTypes

cacheMaxAge.description:
How long a rendered view may be served from cache. Cost data is refreshed
by a 30m compaction job and a 15m matview refresh, so anything shorter
only adds load without adding freshness.
cacheMaxAge.title: cacheMaxAge

types.description:
Config types the cost tab is offered on. Supports globs. Only cloud
resources carry cost, so the tab is scoped to them rather than every
config in the catalog.
types.title: types

enabled.description: If this is set to false, no views will be created
enabled.title: enabled

threshold.description:
Ignore movements smaller than this absolute amount, in the selected
currency. Percentage swings on trivial amounts are noise.
threshold.title: threshold

limit.description: Number of resources listed in the spend table
limit.title: limit

sidebar.description: Show the view in the sidebar
sidebar.title: sidebar

windows.description:
Windows offered in the window selector. Values are interpolated into a
Postgres INTERVAL, so they must be valid interval literals.
windows.title: windows
